task.caption_snippet: Synthetic single-panel Raman benchmark chart, variant 07. Scenario: mapping spot series.
task.special_notes: Benchmark task seeded as a single-panel Raman spectrum benchmark panel; route it through anchoring and curve extraction even if it is not LSV. Inspect the image only and do not use external source files.

anchoring_response.panel_border_completeness: All four plot borders are visible; crop retains axis labels, tick labels, and the full legend.
anchoring_response.interpretation_notes: Single-panel Raman spectrum with five vertically offset spot traces and a legend at upper right. The letters C and D are in-plot peak annotations, not panel labels. No explicit subpanel label is drawn, so the target is the only panel in the figure.

x.visible_pattern: Bottom-axis tick marks are uniformly spaced from 500 to 2500 with constant 250-unit increments.
x.justification: Axis-fit validation selected a linear model with normalized RMSE about 0.0003; the log10 fit was substantially worse.

y.visible_pattern: Left-axis tick marks are uniformly spaced from 0 to 1200 with constant 200-unit increments.
y.justification: Axis-fit validation selected a linear model with normalized RMSE 0.0000, and log10 is incompatible with the visible zero tick.

response.overlap_recovery_reason: The five spot spectra remain visually separable across the full main plot; only intentional dash gaps are present.
response.interpretation_notes: Single main Raman plot with five vertically offset spot traces. The in-plot letters D and G are peak annotations, not separate curves or panel labels.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
